payload.rationale: Brief sets journey_stage dreaming, service_link /destinations and Wedded Concierge secondary, matching the services.md early-stage rule and sister post diamond-buying-guide. Weighted enquiry likelihood is 1.6 and the panel chair ruled the gap structural, telling the writer not to add sales copy, so the primary is the low-pressure destinations hub and no new claims are added. Panel cta_reactions: planner_couple 'maybe, I might browse destinations' (the primary serves exactly this), funding_parent 'maybe' pending fees and deposits, sceptic, search_visitor and uhnw 'no' from a ring article. The one worry the brand can answer, the fee, is already answered before the secondary link ('the fee is agreed in writing before any work begins', brand-facts.md); everything else readers wanted (fee model, deposits, phone line, real weddings, scale) is deferred and logged for the human. The old marker sat after the Concierge paragraph, so the primary rendered after the secondary ask and next to two bridge links; moving it under the 'where' sentence puts the softest ask first and removes the duplicate /destinations link. Existing utm_content=bridge values are normalised to primary (via the block) and secondary. /magazine exists (link-map type magazine, lead magnet) and is the services.md early-stage magnet. The closing FAQ line about a Wedded Advisor stays unlinked to avoid a third Concierge ask. Suggested future magnet, not placed (exists: false on the site): a printable eight-shape try-on card built from the try-on routine and comparison table. No prices. All targets confirmed in content-system/seo/link-map.csv (last_seen 2026-10-20).
